newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo rubber lower, pressured by spot contract.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo rubber lower, pressured by spot contract.

text.p: Tokyo rubber futures ended lower on Thursday, as long liquidation by local investors in spot July pushed down other contracts, traders said.
Prices ranged from 1.6 to 2.8 yen lower, with benchmark December ending down 1.6 yen at 114.4 yen per kg. Estimated volume was 13,308 lots.

All months fell by late morning, as long liquidation in spot July capped the topside, traders said. "We expect the rubber market to fall further until next week," a brokerage house trader said. The spot July expires on July 25.
